Hi Liam / Engage procurement team —

Following our product demo yesterday, quick note to align on a mutual action plan (MAP) for the evaluation assets you requested: testcases, a small prompt pack, and a sample dataset. We want to make sure the delivery cadence fits your procurement review and security checks.

High-level proposal (suggested):
- Week 1 (May 24): Redwood provides a sealed sample prompt pack (CSV) and a 2GB anonymized test slice for functional testing in your sandbox.
- Week 2 (May 31): Provide evaluation harness + runner scripts (ephemeral credentials) and a short acceptance checklist.
- Week 3 (Jun 7): Joint evaluation window; we run two quick regressions and collect prompt-level quality notes.

Usage constraints we suggest up front:
- Assets delivered under an ephemeral evaluation license: no redistribution, no resale.
- Data may be loaded into a secured sandbox only (no long-term persistent logs).
- Outputs used for internal model tuning are permitted only with written permission.
- Retention of raw test artifacts: max 30 days unless otherwise agreed.

I'll attach a draft MAP PDF for your legal/procurement team to review. If procurement has specific redlines, flag them and we'll iterate rapidly — our goal is to keep the close timeline tight so you can finish your POC before your Q3 planning.

Next steps: can procurement confirm (a) any required data handling language and (b) a target signature date?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
